ctccore.chip.hint: Implant it into gear at a Research Station
ctccore.station.status.1: Insert a weapon, armor or tool
ctccore.station.build.short: 3x3 casing floor, 4 corner pillars, 3x3 casing roof with glass in the middle.
ctccore.station.build.3: Middle: this block, casing pillars at the 4 corners
ctccore.station.build.4: Roof: 3x3 Research Casing, glass in the centre
ctccore.station.build.5: Cables, hoppers and pipes connect to any frame block
ctccore.station.build.6: Redstone signal on the core = automatic
ctccore.ponder.research_station.text_1: Start with a 3x3 floor of Research Casing
ctccore.ponder.research_station.text_2: The Research Station goes in the middle, on top of the floor
ctccore.ponder.research_station.text_3: Put a casing pillar on each of the four corners. The middle of each side stays open
ctccore.ponder.research_station.text_4: Finish with a 3x3 casing roof. The block in the middle must be glass
ctccore.ponder.research_station.text_5: When the frame is complete, it lights up and the station is ready
ctccore.ponder.research_station.text_6: Every block of the frame is a port: cables, hoppers and pipes can connect anywhere on it
ctccore.ponder.research_station.text_7: Take one block away and the whole station switches off
ctccore.ponder.research_station_use.head: Implanting chips
ctccore.ponder.research_station_use.text: Open the station and put in a weapon, armor or a tool, a chip and a Uranium Rod
Every implant also needs 60,000 FE. The panel in the middle shows what the chip will do
Iron and weaker gear holds 1 chip, diamond and better 2, a Chip Socket adds one more. A new chip replaces the oldest and gives part of its material back
A redstone signal next to the core makes it automatic: it starts as soon as everything is inside
ctccore.chip.lunar.weapon: Launches the target into the air
ctccore.chip.lunar.armor: Speed, Jump Boost, 60% less fall damage
ctccore.chip.martian.weapon: Sets the target on fire, +10% damage
ctccore.chip.void.armor: 15% chance to phase through a hit
ctccore.chip.remnant.weapon: Heals you for 15% of the damage
ctccore.chip.ember.weapon: Sets the target on fire for 3 s
ctccore.chip.kinetic.armor: Jump again in mid-air to dash forward (4 s), soft landing
ctccore.chip.lumber.weapon: Axe only: fells the whole tree (sneak = one log)
ctccore.chip.vein.tool: Pickaxe only: mines the whole ore vein (sneak = one block)
ctccore.chip.harvest.tool: Hoe only: ripe crops drop more (farming fortune)
ctccore.ponder.voidsteel_melting.text_1: Voidsteel does not melt in a furnace. It needs a Blaze Burner fed with Blaze Cake (superheated)
ctccore.ponder.voidsteel_melting.text_2: Put a Basin on it and a Mechanical Mixer above. Drop in Voidsteel Ore or Raw Voidsteel
ctccore.ponder.voidsteel_melting.text_3: Each piece becomes 250 mB of Molten Voidsteel. Crush the ore first: it gives two raw pieces
ctccore.ponder.voidsteel_melting.text_4: Move the metal with pipes into a Basin under a Mechanical Press. Pressing needs no heat
ctccore.ponder.voidsteel_melting.text_5: Every 250 mB is pressed into one Voidsteel Ingot
ctccore.chip.hint_basic: Smithing Table: this chip + gear + redstone (or a Research Station)
